pages.title: SUPREME COURT'S NEW EMPLOYMENT DIRECTIVE
pages.content: The Supreme Court of India has ordered prompt verification of government job candidates, demanding completion within six months.
pages.image_prompt: An image of the Indian Supreme Court with a team of police officers in the foreground. The officers are amidst a conversation, holding documents which signify the commencement of employee verification. The overlay of a stopwatch signifies the time constraint of six months.

pages.title: SC HIGHLIGHTS ISSUES IN DELAYS
pages.content: The Court underlined that delays in verification disrupt the regularization process and violate principles of natural justice.
pages.image_prompt: Illustrate the Supreme Court Justices highlighting issues with a large red pointer. They are pointing at a giant hourly glass, half filled with sand, symbolizing the delay. Scattered around are symbolic scales of justice, representing the violation of principles of natural justice.

pages.title: CASE STUDY: BLOCKED BENEFICIAL RIGHTS
pages.content: The court cited a case of a 25-year delay before a termination deprived a government servant of his pensionary benefits.
pages.image_prompt: Depict a government servant, appearing dejected, standing outside a government building. He's holding a termination letter, and his badge turned into a ghost, symbolizing his job loss. Nearby is a blurred image of an hourglass indicating the passage of 25 years, and a closed pension book, implying blocked benefits.

pages.title: INDIAN JUDICIARY CRITIQUES LAPSES
pages.content: The enforced termination was deemed illegal and arbitrary, citing a violation of principles of natural justice.
pages.image_prompt: Picture the courthouse with the Indian flag in the background. In the foreground, illustrate a gavel striking a document labeled 'termination,' signifying the illegal and arbitrary decision. Include a broken scale of justice nearby, symbolizing the violation of natural justice.

pages.title: JUDGMENT REINFORCES ADMIN ACCOUNTABILITY
pages.content: The ruling stresses timely verification to avoid delays, uphold justice, and ensure administrative accountability.
pages.image_prompt: Visualize the Supreme Court Justices delivering their ruling. One of the justices is pounding a gavel on a symbolic stopwatch, representing timely verification. Around them are scattered pieces of a jigsaw puzzle, symbolizing administrative accountability, and a radiant scale of justice, highlighting the upholding of justice principles.
